title.narrative: Support to World Bank SEA-MAP Project

description.narrative: The Southeast Asia Regional Program for Combating Marine Plastic was funded by the Embassy of Denmark to Indonesia, Malaysia, Timor-Leste, Papua New Guinea, and ASEAN (the Embassy) through World Bank’s Externally Finance Output (EFO) modality. The agreement was signed on December 13, 2021, with the main objective to enhance understanding of regional opportunities to strengthen innovation, standards, and waste trade to address plastic pollution in the ASEAN region. The EFO was signed in the context of an expanding support by the World Bank to the ASEAN region in the management of plastic waste and minimization of marine debris, including through a comprehensive research and analytical program, and an investment project with ASEAN, the Southeast Asia Regional Program on Combating Marine Plastics (SEA-MaP).

The grant will be used to (1) Provide advice and analysis related to the design of the Plastic Circularity Fund under the Southeast Asia Regional Program on Combat Marine Plastics (SEA-MaP), (2) Carry out a study to identify best practices for plastics standards, and (3) Carry out regional stakeholder consultations and analytical work to build on a World Bank internal options paper on the regional plastic waste trade.
